title: Host Terms, Section 4 — How Many Listings a Host May Hold (Listings)
content:
# Section 4 — How Many Listings a Host May Hold

*Roamhaven host terms, as applied to Roamhaven Listings.*

**4.1** A host may create any number of listings, of any space types. There is no cap on the number of listings a host holds in draft, unlisted or removed status: the number of listings per host is unlimited.

**4.2** The number of **live** listings — listings that are listed or snoozed — a host may hold at once is limited by the host account's tier under the live-listing limits of Roamhaven Listings, and entire-place listings in jurisdictions with a primary-residence rule are further limited under those same limits.

**4.3** Each listing carries its own settings, its own quality record and its own registration. Nothing set on one listing applies to another listing of the same host.

## The section in plain terms

| Status of the listing | Counts toward any cap on how many listings the host holds? |
|---|---|
| draft | no — unlimited |
| unlisted | no — unlimited |
| removed | no — unlimited |
| listed or snoozed (live) | limited by the host account's tier under the live-listing limits |

## Questions the section answers

**A host keeps twelve listings in draft. Is that permitted?**
Yes. Listings held in draft are not capped.

**A host has registered one listing in a jurisdiction. Does that registration number also cover the host's second listing next door?**
No. Each listing carries its own registration; nothing recorded on one listing applies to another.

**A host lowered the cleaning fee on one Entire Home. Does the lower fee carry over to the host's other Entire Home?**
No. Each listing carries its own settings.
